description_en: Queries the reference relationships of a skill
description_zh: 查询 Skill 引用关系
name: ListSkillReferences

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从 1 开始，省略时默认 1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. If this parameter is not specified, the server-side default value is used
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，省略时使用服务端默认值
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Filters results by reference selector type. Valid values: LABEL and VERSION
parameters.help_zh: 按引用选择器类型过滤：LABEL 或 VERSION
parameters.name: selector_type

parameters.help_en: Filters results by reference selector value, such as latest, a named label, HEAD, or a specific version
parameters.help_zh: 按引用选择器值过滤：latest、具名 label、HEAD 或具体版本
parameters.name: selector_value
